overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to convene in closed session on September 21, 2026, to hold a pupil expulsion hearing pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes. The Board was expected to deliberate privately and potentially take action regarding student expulsion if necessary and appropriate.

agenda.item: Motion to convene in closed session pursuant to s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), as well as s. 118.125 of the Wisconsin Statutes to hold a pupil expulsion hearing

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene in closed session to hold a pupil expulsion hearing under Wisconsin Statutes s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), and s. 118.125. The Board was expected to deliberate privately at the conclusion of the hearing and was authorized to take action in closed session if necessary and appropriate. Following the closed session, the Board was expected to entertain a motion to reconvene into open session and consider further action if warranted.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
